## Format

A `data.table` of student-level observations for seven years (across an eight-year span) and two content areas with 17 variables:

`VALID_CASE`

:   Indicator of whether the case is valid or invalid

`CONTENT_AREA`

:   Content area for student observation (ELA or Mathematics)

`YEAR`

:   Year for student observation

`ID`

:   Unique Student Identification Number

`GRADE`

:   Grade level of student observation

`SCALE_SCORE`

:   Student Scale Score

`SCALE_SCORE_without_COVID_IMPACT`

:   Student Scale Score without COVID impact. Original scale score

`ACHIEVEMENT_LEVEL`

:   Achievement level associated with student scale score

`ETHNICITY`

:   Student ethnicity

`FREE_REDUCED_LUNCH_STATUS`

:   Student free/reduced lunch status

`ELL_STATUS`

:   Student English Language Learner status

`IEP_STATUS`

:   Student Individual Education Plan status

`GENDER`

:   Student gender

`SCHOOL_NUMBER`

:   School number associated with student record

`SCHOOL_NAME`

:   School name associated with school number and student record

`DISTRICT_NUMBER`

:   District number associated with student record

`DISTRICT_NAME`

:   District name associated with school number and student record

## Source

Anonymised student level state assessment data in LONG format.

## Usage

``` R
sgpData_LONG_COVID
```

## Description

A subset of seven years of state assessment ELA and mathematics data across an eight-year span, suitable for student growth percentile (SGP) and percentile growth projection/trajectory analyses. The data are missing 2020, to help model COVID-related interruptions to student growth. Each record is one student in one year in one content area.

## Note

Use long format like this with the higher level SGP functions `prepareSGP()`, `analyzeSGP()`, `combineSGP()`, `summarizeSGP()`, `visualizeSGP()` and `outputSGP()`.

## Examples

``` R
head(sgpData_LONG_COVID)
```
